rule_questions: check_writing.md §13 / check_student_facing.md §33: the Pre-reads-before-Module-2 lede ('Optional. The maintainer's line-96 'Slide size accepted' note discusses this section's annotation style but is answering a check_slides.md word-count question, not this one, so it isn't read here as a dispositive accept-note for either concern.
